title: Jerk Chicken
description: Jerk Chicken is a dish from Jamaica featuring chicken leg quarter, jerk marinade, scotch bonnet pepper, thyme. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. A hot grill and oven reproduce home jerk flavor without a traditional pimento-wood smoke pit.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 180 minutes.
Grill jerk-marinated chicken over controlled medium heat to build char without burning the spices; finish until the thickest piece reaches 74°C.
Roast the already seasoned food in a preheated oven until tender and safely cooked, using a thermometer for meat or poultry.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
